branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: How the documents you issue look: your logo at the top, your colour for the title, and your terms at the end.
branding.profileFirst: Save your business details first: they come before the branding on every document.

logo.heading: Logo
logo.hint: A PNG or JPEG of up to {size}. It sits at the top of every document you issue from now on.
logo.wrongType: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
logo.tooLarge: Choose an image of up to {size}.
logo.uploadFailed: The logo didn't reach storage. Check your connection and try again.
logo.broken: This logo can't be shown. Upload it again as a PNG or JPEG image.
logo.removeDescription: Documents you issue from now on have no logo. Documents already issued keep theirs.

details.heading: Colour and terms
details.colourHint: For each document's title and the rule under its header. Leave it empty for the standard blue.
details.colourInvalid: Use a colour like #1f6f5c: a # and six digits or letters from a to f.
details.termsHint: Printed at the end of every document, such as how to pay and what cancelling costs.
